description: This file defines the TlsServerAuthenticationOptions class, which encapsulates SSL/TLS server authentication settings for Orleans connections, including server certificates, protocols, and callback configurations.

classes.name: TlsServerAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates SSL/TLS server authentication options, including server certificate, protocols, revocation mode, and callback.

methods.name: ServerCertificate
methods.description: Gets or sets the server's X509 certificate used for SSL/TLS authentication.

methods.name: ServerCertificateSelectionCallback
methods.description: Gets or sets the callback used to select the server certificate during SSL/TLS handshake.

methods.name: ClientCertificateRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether a client certificate is required for authentication.

methods.name: EnabledSslProtocols
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSL protocols enabled for the connection.

methods.name: CertificateRevocationCheckMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the revocation mode for certificate validation.

methods.name: SslServerAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying SslServerAuthenticationOptions object.
